title: Undergraduate Civil Engineer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
rationale: Casual undergraduate placement (about 3 days/week) aimed at current 3rd/4th year Civil Engineering students; Marc has already finished his qualifications.

Gold Coast QLD is outside Melbourne but within Marc's stated openness to relocate for work.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast; the role targets enrolled students, which is the main mismatch to check.
gaps: Whether a completed graduate would be considered for this student placement
